budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Fulfill four physical soup orders while coordinating reusable bowls, cooking/cleaning utensils and finite-capacity clean/waste water infrastructure.
task.natural_termination: Natural end when each of the four customers has either been served or left after its own patience expired. H=256 is the upper truncation window; natural causes take priority.
task.interaction: An upstream wash consumes shared clean water and creates sink dirt. Opening its drain moves dirty parcels toward the coworker's pan unless a physical filter or diversion catches them. Tool exchange transfers preparation and cleaning capabilities between the two workers.
task.observation_access: Fully observable compact kitchen. Both roles receive identical flat native maps, actors/items/tools and holders, clean/prepared/filled/age/spoiled flags, every drainage-cell parcel, tank/sink/basin/filter/pan state, customer patience/outcomes and reward components. Inactive ingredients and completed orders remain fixed slots in observations but disappear from active scene groups.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Filter is physically installed at valve
Fresh spoilage plus deliberate food-disposal events

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
